name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.219: Subtitles of a friend's or linked server's title now come from that server even when it converts no video for you. Before, a separate subtitle file (one stored beside the film) failed to load, because only the server holding the file can read it. Fonts for styled subtitles come the same way. Both servers need 0.0.219. Burning such a subtitle into the picture on this server is still not possible.
